description: Create a person record: someone items can be assigned to. This is NOT a login account; create_invite invites someone into the app, and an accepted invite links to a person record (matched by email where possible). Optional email and parent person id (grouping, e.g. a department). Not idempotent: a repeated call creates a second record. Requires the manager role.

email.description: Email (used to link an account later)

parentId.description: Parent person resource id for grouping (omit for top level)

name: create_person
title: Create person
